title: A Race-Free Counter
prompt: Implement `hammer` spawning `nThreads` threads that each increment `counter` `incs` times. Total increments must be exact — the counters prove atomicity.

tests.name: total is exact across threads
tests.hint: Spawn threads with std::thread, each runs a for-loop of counter.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed), then join every thread before returning.

tests.name: single-thread sanity
tests.hint: Same path, one thread — guards against off-by-one in the loop.
